sections.title: Investment Research and Financial Intelligence RAG
sections.description: For JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and New York's investment banking research community.

blocks.heading: Equity research corpus RAG
paragraphs: RAG over the enormous volume of investment research that New York's major investment banks produce — enabling research analysts to query the firm's historical research, financial models, and market commentary in natural language for context on specific companies, industries, or markets. JPMorgan and Goldman collectively publish thousands of research notes per month; RAG makes this institutional knowledge queryable rather than archival.

blocks.heading: SEC filing and earnings intelligence RAG
paragraphs: RAG over SEC EDGAR filings, earnings call transcripts, and public company financial disclosures for New York's investment management community — enabling portfolio managers and analysts to ask natural language questions about specific companies or sectors and receive answers drawn from the primary source filings.

blocks.heading: Credit research and structured products RAG
paragraphs: RAG over the credit research, bond prospectus, and structured product documentation for New York's large fixed income investment management community — querying the complex documentation of structured credit, CLO, and mortgage-backed securities in natural language.

sections.title: Legal Knowledge and Precedent RAG
sections.description: For Sullivan & Cromwell, Skadden, Davis Polk, Cravath, and New York's elite BigLaw community.

blocks.heading: M&A and deal documentation RAG
paragraphs: RAG over deal documentation libraries, EDGAR M&A filings, and firm precedent for New York's large M&A practices — enabling deal teams to query precedent transaction terms, regulatory filing requirements, and market practice on specific deal structures in natural language.

blocks.heading: Regulatory compliance intelligence RAG
paragraphs: RAG over the SEC, CFTC, OCC, NYDFS, and Federal Reserve regulatory materials for the compliance and regulatory practices at New York's largest law firms.

blocks.heading: Cross-border transaction RAG
paragraphs: RAG for New York's international practices — querying treaty frameworks, cross-border regulatory requirements, and international deal precedent for the transactions that cross US, European, and Asian regulatory jurisdictions.

sections.title: Healthcare Clinical Knowledge RAG

blocks.heading: Oncology knowledge RAG
paragraphs: RAG for the oncology programs at Memorial Sloan Kettering and NewYork-Presbyterian's cancer programs — querying clinical trial eligibility criteria, NCCN guidelines, and tumor board reference materials in natural language.

blocks.heading: New York State health law RAG
paragraphs: RAG for the complex intersection of New York State health privacy law (Public Health Law Article 27-F, Mental Hygiene Law) with federal HIPAA requirements — enabling clinical administrators and compliance officers to query New York's distinctive health privacy framework.
